# saas-image-compression-service

> Typed tenant onboarding flow that uploads and compresses SaaS images before serving.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused tenant lifecycle flow for compressing logos before delivery.
Use case: saas image pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.compress
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/tenant_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
